description: This file contains unit tests for tailnet helper functions, testing network interface filtering, address detection, and mock behavior in a testing framework.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Performs cleanup after each test case, restoring mocks to original state.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite named 'tailnet helpers'.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that certain conditions are true in tests.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: vi.restoreAllMocks
methods.description: Restores all mocked functions to their original implementations.

methods.name: vi.spyOn
methods.description: Creates spies on existing functions to mock their behavior during tests.

methods.name: makeNetworkInterfacesSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a mock snapshot of network interfaces for testing.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IP address belongs to a tailnet IPv4 range.

methods.name: listTailnetAddresses
methods.description: Lists all non-internal tailnet IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from network interfaces.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Selects the first available tailnet IPv4 address.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv6
methods.description: Selects the first available tailnet IPv6 address.
